{{short description|Paraguayan football season}}{{One source|date=June 2025}}

The '''1990 season of the [[Paraguayan Primera División]]''', the top category of [[Paraguay]]an football, was played by 12 teams. The national champions were [[Cerro Porteño]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Paraguay 1990 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesp/para90.html |access-date=2025-06-08 |website=www.rsssf.org}}</ref>
